verdict.rationale: The evidence documents no public REST or HTTP API, and probes for OpenAPI or Swagger specs all returned 404. The only programmatic interface is a read-only MCP connector for AI assistants, which belongs to a separate MCP-server story and does not let a user drive the product, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: answered from your live Cap Table in Cake. All read-only.
